palette.neutrals: platform --bg / --surface (white and pale grey, near-black in dark)

type.display: ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", system-ui (headings, big counts)
type.labels: system-ui 12-13px, sentence case, weight for hierarchy

layout: Home: header with today's date, then a two-column top (Water today checklist card | 14-day watering schedule), then the windowsill: every plant as a pot on a wooden shelf per window, filterable by window. Plant page: hero (large pot, name, botanical name, next water, facts), a care-rhythm timeline, log card beside history, details behind a disclosure. One column on phones in the order answer, action, visual, rest.
signature: Drawn pots: each plant is an SVG pot whose blue fill is how much of its watering interval is left; the foliage (blades, broad leaves, trailing vines or a bush, picked from the name or species) wilts and yellows when thirsty or late. Plus a 14-day schedule grid with water drops and feed dots, and a care-rhythm timeline whose watering gaps turn red when they ran longer than planned.
mood: A calm, friendly windowsill: leaf green and water blue on neutral white or near-black, warm shelf wood, rounded type.
